first_instructions: ldmdami r3, {r2, r3, r6, r8, lr} ^
eoreq fp, r5, r0, lsl ip

ldmibge sl!, {r0, r2, r3, r4, r5, r6, r7, r8, sb, fp, ip, sp, lr}

stmdblt r8, {r5, r6, sb, fp, ip, sp, lr} ^
stmdblt r0, {r0, r5, r6, sb, sl, fp, sp} ^
stmdblt r0, {r1, r2, r6, r7, sl} ^
stmdbge r1, {r0, r1, r4, r5, r6, r7, r8, sb, ip, lr}
stmdbge r4, {r0, r3, r4, r5, r6, r7, r8, sb, fp, sp, lr}
stmdbge r5, {r0, r1, r3, r4, r5, r6, r7, r8, sb, ip, sp, lr}
andeq r5, sl, r5, ror sp
subpl r4, pc, fp, asr r7
